title: Tosefta Tevul Yom
attributionNote: The Sefaria catalogue records this as a composite or traditionally transmitted work. Authorship is not asserted here beyond the source's own metadata.
description: The status of a person in the time between their immersion in a mikvah and sunset of that day. Complete Tosefta text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: The Tosefta is a collection of rabbinic traditions parallel to and supplementing the Mishnah. Its relationship to the Mishnah is debated; it is presented here as a distinct legal corpus.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
